verdict.rationale: Milvus Lite is documented as a Python library that runs inside the application. A local database is created just by passing a file name to MilvusClient. Standalone mode on Docker covers single-machine local instances, and the same client code carries over to larger deployments. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Milvus Lite embedded usage, and detail on which features Lite lacks (docs say it covers only 'most of the features').

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads

citations.quote: To create a local Milvus vector database, simply instantiate a `MilvusClient` by specifying a file name to store all data

Milvus Lite is a Python library that can be easily integrated into your applications. As a lightweight version of Milvus, it’s ideal for quick prototyping in Jupyter Notebooks or running on edge devices
With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container
Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.
